items.title: Abby Foster Interview, 1960-06-29
items.q: Some people have told me that the old man, uh, Louie Tio and, uh, Lorenzo Senior came from Mexico.

ctx.x: Well, really I could not say that. Mm-hmm.
Some people have told me that the old man, uh, Louie Tio and, uh, Lorenzo Senior came from Mexico.
